办公室里传来一道女声，干练而又带着一丝妩媚。

她的身材也极好，蹬着一双红色高跟鞋，穿着职业套装，十分迷人。
“咦，她竟然是狐媚之体！”
看着眼前的班主任，陈阳感到十分吃惊。
狐媚之体非常稀有，天生对男人拥有致命的吸引力，不仅能给男人带来极大的欢愉，甚至能把男人的魂勾走，让男人不由自主地听其命令。

虽然眼前这位班主任杨雪薇还没修炼自己的体质，但也不是普通人能抗拒，陈阳难以想象，她班级里的男学生会有多乖。
“杨老师你好，我是你们班的插班生，我叫陈阳。”
回过神来，陈阳不冷不淡地给杨雪薇打了声招呼，倒不是他不喜欢美女，而是因为曾今的经历，让他对拥有狐媚之体的女人多了几分防备心。
杨雪薇看着一脸平淡的陈阳，心里的吃惊不亚于陈阳发现了她的体质，因为自从六岁之后，她还从来没见过哪个男人第一次见到自己，还能如此镇定。
顿时，她对陈阳产生了几分好感。
“跟我来，正好下节课是我的。”
杨雪薇走在前面，带着陈阳朝着下节课的教室走去，一边走一边说道：“我看了你的资料，今年已经二十岁才读大一，想必成绩不会太好，你能到我们东安工大来插班，应该是托了不少关系，希望你能好好学习，不要错过这个机会。”
陈阳心头暗笑，虽然自己麻省理工学院的硕士文凭是黑进系统自己弄的，但也是真实存在，有迹可查的。而且我堂堂全球知名的黑客，你竟然让我好好学习大一的计算机基础课程，确定这不是开玩笑。
虽然心里腹诽，陈阳表面上还是答应道：“好的，杨老师，我会努力的。”
“你有这个心就好，我以后会照顾你的。”杨雪薇回头看了眼陈阳，微微一笑，眼眸中媚意如春，差点没把陈阳给迷倒。
还好陈阳不是普通人，这才把持住。

如果让别人知道杨雪薇竟然露出了笑容，只怕整个学校都会轰动，都会羡慕陈阳。
要说杨雪薇在东安工大的名气是相当大，是无数男老师、男学生的女神，甚至是好些人夜深人静时脑海中猥琐的对象。
不过无论面对谁，杨雪薇都是一副扑克脸，没有男人见她笑过，让好些追求她的人都吃了闭门羹。
甚至传言有一位市长公子苦苦追求，她都不屑一顾。
而她当班主任的计算机科学与技术二班，也是东安工大的一个传奇，虽然是大一班级，但却在整个东安工大拥有极大的名气。因为除了这位媚到骨子里的性感美女老师之外，计科二班还有一位清纯到极点的校花，以及一位嚣张无比的大姐头。
去教室的路上，杨雪薇给陈阳介绍了一些学校的基本情况，两人不知不觉就到了教室，一起走了进去。
一见杨雪薇，哄闹的教室立即安静下来，男生们的目光全都聚焦过来，似乎恨不得眼睛都贴在她身上。
杨雪薇似乎习惯了别人的目光，淡定地介绍起陆凡，道：“这位是陈阳同学，是咱们班级的插班生，希望大家能和他友善相处，共同进步。”
全班同学看向了陈阳，顿时有人惊呼起来：“这不是骑那辆快散架的凤凰牌二八大杠的家伙吗，他竟然和我们一个班。”
凤凰牌二八大杠？
杨雪薇眼中闪过疑惑之色，但并没有询问怎么回事，对陈阳道：“你找个位置先坐下，教材的话，中午让学习委员带你去教材科领取。”
“谢谢杨老师。”
陈阳道了声谢，朝着讲台下走去，可刚走到第一排，他就停住了脚步。
在他面前，居然是之前遇到的那位白裙飘飘的清纯女孩。

"Please come in."
A female voice came from the office, capable and yet a little charming.
Chen Yang pushed the door open and saw a woman sitting behind the desk. She was quickly putting away the information in her hands, then stood up and looked up at Chen Yang.
The head teacher, Yang Xuewei, is unexpectedly beautiful. Her face is very pretty, and the small mole at the corner of her mouth is full of charm. Her pretty face pretends to be stern, but she can't hide the charm in her eyes. The light that flows from time to time in her eyes is intoxicating.
She also has a great figure. She is wearing a pair of red high heels and a professional suit, which makes her very charming.
"Hey, she turns out to be charming!"
Looking at the class teacher in front of him, Chen Yang was very surprised.
The charming body is very rare. It is born with a fatal attraction to men. It can not only bring great joy to men, but can even draw away the soul of men, making men involuntarily obey its orders.
Chen Yang never expected that he would meet a teacher with a charming body in school. You must know that even he, Zeng Jin, almost fell into the hands of a woman with a charming body.
Although Yang Xuewei, the class teacher in front of her, has not yet perfected her physique, it is not something ordinary people can resist. Chen Yang could not imagine how well-behaved the male students in her class would be.
"Hello, Teacher Yang, I am a transfer student in your class. My name is Chen Yang."
After coming back to his senses, Chen Yang greeted Yang Xuewei calmly. It was not that he didn't like beauties, but because Zeng Jin's experience made him more wary of women with charming bodies.
Yang Xuewei looked at Chen Yang with a plain face, and was as surprised as Chen Yang when he discovered her physique, because since she was six years old, she had never seen a man be so calm when he saw her for the first time.
Suddenly, she felt a little fond of Chen Yang.
"Follow me, the next class happens to be mine."
Yang Xuewei walked in front, leading Chen Yang towards the classroom for the next class. As she walked, she said: "I read your information. You are already twenty years old and you are in your first year of college. I guess your grades will not be very good. You must have a lot of connections to join us at Dong'an University of Technology. I hope you can study hard and don't miss this opportunity."
Chen Yang chuckled to himself. Although his master's degree from MIT was obtained by hacking into the system, it was real and traceable. Moreover, I am a world-famous hacker, and you actually asked me to study the basic computer courses in my freshman year. I am sure this is not a joke.
Although he complained in his heart, Chen Yang still agreed on the surface: "Okay, Teacher Yang, I will work hard."
"As long as you have this intention, I will take care of you in the future." Yang Xuewei looked back at Chen Yang and smiled slightly, her eyes were as charming as spring, and she almost charmed Chen Yang.
Fortunately, Chen Yang was not an ordinary person, so he took control.
If others knew that Yang Xuewei actually smiled, the whole school would be shocked and envious of Chen Yang.
Yang Xuewei is quite famous in Dong'an University of Technology. She is the goddess of countless male teachers and male students, and is even the object of obscenity in many people's minds in the dead of night.
However, no matter who she faced, Yang Xuewei always had a poker face. No man had ever seen her smile, and many people who pursued her were turned away.
There were even rumors that a mayor's son was pursuing her hard, but she dismissed it.
The Computer Science and Technology Class 2 of which she is the class teacher is also a legend at Dong'an Polytechnic University. Although it is a freshman class, it has a great reputation throughout Dong'an Polytechnic University. Because in addition to this sexy and beautiful teacher who is charming to the core, there is also an extremely pure school belle in Class 2 of the Department of Economics, and an extremely arrogant eldest sister.
On the way to the classroom, Yang Xuewei introduced some basic information about the school to Chen Yang. The two of them arrived at the classroom without knowing it and walked in together.
When I saw Yang Xuewei, the noisy classroomShe immediately became quiet, and all the boys' eyes were focused on her, as if they wanted to have their eyes on her.
Yang Xuewei seemed to be used to other people's eyes, and calmly introduced Lu Fan, saying: "This is classmate Chen Yang, a transfer student in our class. I hope everyone can get along well with him and make progress together."
The whole class looked at Chen Yang, and someone suddenly exclaimed: "Isn't this the guy riding that Phoenix brand 28 big bar that's about to fall apart? He's actually in the same class as us."
Phoenix card 28 big kong?
A look of confusion flashed in Yang Xuewei's eyes, but she didn't ask what was going on. She said to Chen Yang, "You find a seat and sit down first. As for the textbooks, ask the study committee member to take you to the textbook department at noon to get them."
"Thank you, Teacher Yang."
Chen Yang thanked him and walked towards the podium, but as soon as he reached the first row, he stopped.
In front of him was the innocent girl in a fluttering white dress whom he met before.
